1395-4068-5078-8171.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
1395-4068-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska and Elsha's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn
Resolve the Vraska trigger, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2169-4694-6798-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2169-4694-6798-7306.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {U}{G}, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, surveiling 1.
Repeat from step 2.

465-585-3742-4251-4460.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Phantom Steed to become a Samurai until end of turn.
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping it and all Samurai you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

654-851-1308-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3756-5231-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Izzet Boilerworks.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Izzet Boilerworks from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Repeat.

3234-3946-5256-7776.description:
While Glacial Chasm is on the battlefield, all damage that would be dealt to you is prevented.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Glacial Chasm triggers. Choose not to pay its cumulative upkeep cost and sacrifice it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, its second ability triggers, returning Glacial Chasm and Mortuary Mire from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Glacial Chasm and Mortuary Mire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Glacial Chasm trigger, sacrificing Mortuary Mire.
Resolve the Mortuary Mire trigger, putting World Shaper from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 3.
Move to your next turn, drawing World Shaper during your draw step.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Glacial Chasm triggers. Choose not to pay its cumulative upkeep cost and sacrifice it.
Cast World Shaper by paying {3}{G}.
Repeat from step 3.
3234-3946-5256-7776.notes: If your life total allows, you can instead opt to pay Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep cost. If you do this, you can forego doing this loop during that turn.

3129-4659-5086-5183-6996.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
3129-4659-5086-5183-6996.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

1558-3875-4231-5233-6441.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3875-4231-5233-6441.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4742-7279.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4742-7279.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker.
Razorkin Hordecaller triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1738-5306-5755.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
1738-5306-5755.description:
Activate Disciple of Griselbrand by paying {1} and sacrificing Serra Avatar, causing you to gain life equal to Serra Avatar's toughness.
Enduring Tenacity triggers, causing target opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.

1399-1606-1671-5396.description:
Cast Trickery Charm by paying {U}, causing Ley Weaver to become an Elf until end of turn.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2.

1818-5670-6792--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1818-5670-6792--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

1479-5621-6754.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5621-6754.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it, Eusocial Engineering, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Eusocial Engineering trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Eusocial Engineering trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2425-4050-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2425-4050-6249--5.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the persist creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the persist creature dies, it and Smothering Abomination trigger.
Resolve the Smothering Abomination trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Repeat.

1447-1734-2921.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Angel of Glory's Rise.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Angel of Glory's Rise from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1174-1479-3703.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control two lands that can tap to produce at least {2}, one of which must enter the battlefield untapped.
1174-1479-3703.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Play the land returned to your hand in step 2.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama and Sporemound trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers.
Holding priority, activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Resolve the Kodama trigger from step 7, putting the land returned to your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Sporemound triggers, creating a token.
Repeat from step 7.

2653-4806-5702.notablePrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2653-4806-5702.description:
Activate Blinkmoth Nexus's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Blinkmoth Nexus's second ability by paying {1}, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to Blinkmoth Nexus.
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Nissa trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Blinkmoth Nexus.
When the Blinkmoth Nexus token enters the battlefield, Nissa and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate the Blinkmoth Nexus token's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Repeat from step 6.

requires.n: Artifact Creature that is a Gnome and/or Artificer

2034-2527-4073-4917--75.notablePrerequisites:
Jan Jansen and the additional Gnome or Artificer do not have a +1/+1 counter on them.
You control at least one additional artifact creature.
2034-2527-4073-4917--75.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact creature you control except the Gnome or Artificer.
Jan Jansen triggers, causing it and creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jan Jansen, adding {C}{C}.
When Jan Jansen dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing the Gnome or Artificer.
When the Gnome or Artificer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Retribution of the Ancients by paying {B} and removing the +1/+1 counter from Jan Jansen and the other Gnome or Artificer, giving a creature -2/-2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 4.

3841-4050-4770-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
Torens triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Cat and Human Soldier, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

678-4050-4151-5921.description:
Cast Vishgraz by paying {2}{W}{B}{G}.
When Vishgraz enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating six 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Vishgraz, adding {W}.
When Vishgraz dies, Enduring Renewal triggers twice, returning Vishgraz from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Phyrexian Mites, adding {2}{B}{G}.
Repeat.

1571-1990-4452-5728.notablePrerequisites: Aspiring Champion does not have summoning sickness, and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1571-1990-4452-5728.description:
Cast Worldly Tutor by paying {G}, searching your library for Blightsteel Colossus and putting it on top of your library.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Aspiring Champion.
Aspiring Champion triggers, causing you to sacrifice it, then reveal Blightsteel Colossus from the top of your library and put it onto the battlefield as a Demon due to Rukarumel, Biologist, then causing Blightsteel Colossus to give each opponent eleven poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.

1329-3169-3734-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Phyrexian Metamorph is a copy of Genesis Chamber.
Enough additional mana and/or artifacts on the battlefield to make up for Emry's command tax (if applicable).
1329-3169-3734-4050.description:
Cast Emry by paying {U} plus commander tax (if applicable).
When Emry enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, Genesis Chamber, and the copy of Genesis Chamber.
Resolve both Genesis Chamber triggers, creating two 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Resolve Emry's ability, milling four cards.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Emry, adding {U}.
Send Emry from the graveyard to the command zone as a state-based action.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite creature tokens, you may activate Phyrexian Altar any number of times.

2724-3942-3987-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a creature spell using Karador this turn.
2724-3942-3987-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wormfang Manta, adding {U}.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger when it enters the battlefield due to Torpor Orb.
Repeat each turn.

1978-2364-3789.description:
Animate Mana Vault using The Blackstaff of Waterdeep.
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Mana Vault.
Repeat from step 2.

4-1367-2334.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Soulherder's second ability triggers, blinking Hoarding Broodlord.
When Hoarding Broodlord enters the battlefield, it and Soulherder's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Soulherder trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Hoarding Broodlord trigger, searching your library for Nexus of Fate if it's in your library, and exiling it.
Cast Nexus of Fate either from your hand or from exile by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Repeat each turn.

2608-4249-4499.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least five.
2608-4249-4499.description:
Activate Nykthos's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {5}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Nykthos.
Repeat.
